content: The Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II, addressed to Shāhrukh's son Bāysunghur, details the enormity of Ibn Turka's tribulations in exile and seeks Bāysunghur's intercession with the sultan, 'to little real effect'; it is accompanied by a very brief formal statement of creed, the R. Iʿtiqādiyya (note 95).
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II; R. Iʿtiqādiyya
